summary.key_theme: iPhone Duo 的強勁預購需求與市值突破 5 兆美元，展現了 Apple 在高階摺疊機市場的定價能力與 AI 策略布局的成功。

bullish.title: iPhone Duo Preorders Sell Out Rapidly As Delivery Estimates Slip Into January
bullish.reason: iPhone Duo 預購需求極為強勁，交貨期已排至 2027 年 1 月，顯示消費者對 1,999 美元高價位摺疊機的高度接受度，有利於提升平均售價 (ASP)。

bullish.title: iPhone Duo Preorders, AAPL Crosses $5 Trillion and More: This Week in Appleverse
bullish.reason: Apple 市值正式突破 5 兆美元大關，反映市場對其生態系與 AI 轉型的高度信心，鞏固其全球科技龍頭地位。

bullish.title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
bullish.reason: Apple 與 Meta 合作將 Muse AI 模型導入 Mac，強化了 Apple 硬體在 AI 運算領域的競爭力，有助於推動高階 Mac 的銷售。

bullish.title: Apple's iPhone Duo Demand Tracking 'Solidly Out Of The Gate', Says Analyst As AAPL Stock Caps Off Best Week Since September Launch
bullish.reason: Evercore ISI 等機構分析師確認預購需求強勁，且股價表現強勢，顯示市場對新產品週期的樂觀預期。

bearish.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
bearish.reason: AI 穿戴裝置的隱私問題引發法律疑慮，可能對 Apple 的品牌聲譽與未來監管環境造成潛在壓力。

bearish.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to get chip manufacturing space at TSMC
bearish.reason: 台積電產能吃緊，Apple 與 Nvidia 等巨頭競爭晶片製造空間，可能導致供應鏈瓶頸並影響產品出貨效率。

neutral.title: AAPL, TSLA, NFLX, GME, RKLB: Why Retail Traders Couldn’t Take Their Eyes Off These Stocks Last Week
neutral.reason: 僅提及散戶對 Apple 股票的關注度，屬於市場情緒觀察，對公司基本面無直接影響。

neutral.title: Own VGT? Here's How Much of It Is Really Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, and Broadcom.
neutral.reason: 分析科技 ETF 的持股權重，屬於投資組合配置分析，對 Apple 本身股價無直接催化作用。
